\section[\texorpdfstring{\mr{दाखवणे} (dākhavṇe)}{दाखवणे (dākhavṇe)}]{\mr{दाखवणे} (dākhavṇe) — to show}

\label{lesson:MR-C156-dakhavne}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Marathi for to paint, then the Marathi for to take out.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \mr{दाखवणे}}
\textbf{\mr{दाखवणे}} — \emph{dākhavṇe} — \textquotedblleft{}to show\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\mr{दाखवणे}} (\emph{dākhavṇe}) is the \textquotedblleft{}make someone see\textquotedblright{} form of an old verb for \textquotedblleft{}see\textquotedblright{}: CDIAL lists it, in its addenda, under a reconstructed \emph{*dṛkṣati}, \textquotedblleft{}sees\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 6507).
\end{cousinweb}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\mr{ओरडणे} (oraḍṇe)}{ओरडणे (oraḍṇe)}]{\mr{ओरडणे} (oraḍṇe) — to shout}

\label{lesson:MR-C156-oradne}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Marathi for to show, then the Marathi for to play.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \mr{ओरडणे}}
\textbf{\mr{ओरडणे}} — \emph{oraḍṇe} — \textquotedblleft{}to shout\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\mr{ओरडणे}} (\emph{oraḍṇe}) is a tadbhava, a word inherited and reshaped by sound change. It comes from \emph{*uparaṭati}, \textquotedblleft{}shouts to\textquotedblright{}, a form CDIAL reconstructs from its descendants (CDIAL 2211). It is \emph{upa}, \textquotedblleft{}to\textquotedblright{}, and \emph{raṭ}, \textquotedblleft{}to cry\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}
